title: Clay
what: What the browser holds is the material being worked, not the output of anything. Every thing is named as it enters, and three words work on names: make, put, set.
rule: Sentences are data. Nothing in them is run as code, and nothing leaves the browser.
proves: a thing is named as it enters
a name is never handed to another thing
things can be moved, nested and taken out
touching a name puts it in the line
touching a thing makes it it
a thing can be taught sentences and says them when touched
a taught thing can teach the things it makes
the world is there on the next visit
putting the world out forgets it
